lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank. Three primary vertical columns are discernible posterior to the gill region, with the most prominent column containing three large, high-intensity centroids aligned vertically.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid-like pattern. These intersections are most pronounced in the mid-flank region superior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal ridge is visible running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger, more uniform blobs on the main body flank.
